# Legacy archive compatibility fixtures

These frozen gzip/tar layers were generated by the unchanged `writeTarLayer`
from `pkg/runner/oci/archive/tar.go` at baseline commit
`bfaecd142a6e765591dd7c217d02d2b4703e93ee`, not the current tar writer.

Both inputs contain executable `real/file` (0755), with contents
`legacy executable\n`. The directory links are:

- `legacy-dot-link.tar.gz`: `a -> ./real`.
- `legacy-chain-links.tar.gz`: `a -> real`, `b -> a`.

Each input was passed directly as `FileRef{AbsPath, RelPath}` to that writer.
The tests wrap the frozen bytes in legacy ORAS directory-layer annotations and
perform an actual ORAS copy into the archive store.
